svg.text: ETLPlus: CSV exports must behave exactly like JSON
The nightly order export switched from JSON to CSV, and the team's etlplus pipeline now fails validation and computes wrong totals. The agent fixes etlplus in /app
so that a job reading CSV gives the same result it gives on the same records as JSON.

generated exports, each run as CSV
